question: Who are brought near and pleased, and whose boon-givers then, with what retinue?
premises: then too they are brought near, they are pleased, boon-givers then
of goddesses now, of the lord, attendant-joined too indeed
inference: Nearness and pleasure make boon-givers of the goddess-lord retinue.
plain_english: Then too they are brought near, they are pleased, boon-givers then — of goddesses now, of the lord, attendant-joined too indeed.
